import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD1_CONST = 998244353L;
    static final long MOD2_CONST = 1000000007L;

    static long total_n_value;
    static List<Integer>[] buckets_list = new ArrayList[10];
    static long[] prefix_sum_list = new long[10];
    static long count_total1 = 0, count_total2 = 0, answer_total = 0;
    static int[] power_vals = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000};

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            buckets_list[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static long readNumber(BufferedReader br) throws IOException {
        long num = 0;
        int sign_flag = 1;
        int ch;
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1) break;
            if (ch == '-') {
                sign_flag = -1;
                break;
            }
            if (Character.isDigit(ch)) {
                num = (num << 1) + (num << 3) + (ch - '0');
                break;
            }
        }
        while (true) {
            ch = br.read();
            if (ch == -1 || !Character.isDigit(ch)) break;
            num = (num << 1) + (num << 3) + (ch - '0');
        }
        return num * sign_flag;
    }

    static void generate_all(int length, long val) {
        if (length > 6) return;
        long modVal = (count_total1 - val + MOD1_CONST) % MOD1_CONST;
        buckets_list[length].add((int) modVal);
        prefix_sum_list[length] += modVal;
        count_total1++;
        for (int digit = 0; digit <= 9; digit++) {
            generate_all(length + 1, val * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static boolean is_in_range(long x) {
        return x * 1000000 + 999999 <= total_n_value && x * 10000000 > total_n_value;
    }

    static void traverse(int length, long val) {
        if (val > total_n_value) return;
        if (is_in_range(val)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long v1 = ((count_total2 + 1 - val * power_vals[i]) % MOD1_CONST + MOD1_CONST) % MOD1_CONST;
                List<Integer> list = buckets_list[i];
                int idx = lowerBound(list, (int)(MOD1_CONST - v1));
                long sum_buckets = prefix_sum_list[i];
                long size = list.size();
                long term = (sum_buckets + size * v1 - (long)MOD1_CONST * (size - idx)) % MOD2_CONST;
                answer_total = (answer_total + term) % MOD2_CONST;
            }
            count_total2 += count_total1;
        } else {
            if (length != 0) {
                count_total2++;
            }
            long temp = ((count_total2 - val) % MOD1_CONST + MOD1_CONST) % MOD1_CONST;
            answer_total = (answer_total + temp) % MOD2_CONST;
            for (int digit = (length == 0 ? 1 : 0); digit <= 9; digit++) {
                traverse(length + 1, val * 10 + digit);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int target) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= target) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        total_n_value = readNumber(br);
        generate_all(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(buckets_list[i]);
        }
        traverse(0, 0);
        System.out.println(answer_total);
    }
}
